title: Route Truck Use in the Last Active Year of a Suspended Route-Level Ship-To
content:
A route-level Ship-To Fulfillment Account that used little route service before it went quiet comes back lower when it is reactivated.

**Rule.** Route drops follow how much a ship-to holding Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To used its route service in its last active year, the lines dated at least D and fewer than D plus 12 whole months before the reactivation date, D being the whole months from its last order date to the reactivation date: two drops for such a route-level ship-to with no shipped order line shipped by route truck in that year, one drop for such a route-level ship-to with at least one and fewer than 6 such route truck shipments, and none for every other ship-to, a ship-to with no last order date having no last active year and so no route drop.

Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

**What counts.** Each shipped order line of the ship-to whose ship method is route truck and whose date falls in the last active year is one route truck shipment. The level read is the level the suspended ship-to holds.

| Level held | Route truck shipments in the last active year | Route drops |
|---|---|---|
| a route level | 0 | 2 |
| a route level | 1 to 5 | 1 |
| a route level | 6 or more | none |
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To or Corbett Priority Ship-To | any | none |
| any level, no last order date | not applicable | none |

**Hypothetical window.** Last order 8 whole months before the reactivation date, so D is 8: the last active year is the lines dated at least 8 and fewer than 20 whole months before the reactivation date. A route truck line dated 20 whole months before falls outside it; one dated 8 whole months before falls inside it.
